items.text: Your thumb still throbs—what's the story?
Did the fire ever finish nudging you?
How's the east wall holding up now?
What did you think of that glass shard?
Is the forge finally feeling like home?
Do you ever miss the roof’s warmth?
That cracked stone—do you think it'll hold?
Why does the fire stay so quiet now?
Did the new roof board sing when you nailed it?
How's the glasshouse vibe with those seedlings?
Do the woodshed logs ever argue with each other?
Is the east wall whispering anything as you work?
